description: The cache of imported modules by name; `import` checks it first, and a module is stored there before its code runs.
An object on `sys.meta_path` whose `find_spec(name, path, target)` returns a `ModuleSpec` for names it serves and `None` otherwise.
Creates and executes a module: `create_module(spec)` (or `None` for the default) and `exec_module(module)`.
Describes how to load a module: `name`, `loader`, `origin`, `parent` and `submodule_search_locations` (a package's `__path__`).
Finds the module's spec again and re-executes its code in the same module object, keeping old globals that are not redefined.
